acceptance_criteria: Concurrent cold starts do not spawn split-brain daemons; cold-start failures surface a useful cause; stale incompatible daemons are recoverable instead of silently poisoning runs.
description: Fix split-brain cold-start races, make startup failures diagnosable, and avoid permanent poisoning from stale/protocol-mismatched daemons.

notes.author: darin@book
notes.content: Audit: verified in /Users/darin/Projects/raql on jj change 3f67e964fc22. Hardened daemon startup with protocol-versioned sockets, spawn-lock retention through readiness, captured startup logs, and concurrent cold-start coverage. Verification: cargo test -p raql-daemon && cargo test --test cli_daemon_cutover -- --nocapture && cargo test --test cli_strict_runtime -- --nocapture.

title: Harden daemon cold-start, reuse, and startup diagnostics
